description.p: Signature Viewer is a GNOME application to open digitally signed files and verify the contained digital signatures.
It supports:

ul.li: .p7m (CAdES) files, including nested and multiple signatures
.pdf (PAdES) files, with an in-app preview showing where each signature was applied
Full signer details: name, tax code, organization, certificate validity, signing time
Trust chain validation using the system trust store and the European Trusted Service List (TSL)
Extraction and preview of the original document contained in a CAdES envelope

description.p: Support hybrid-reference signed PDFs and clarify the message shown when a signature is intact but its certificate is expired.
Make diagnostic save/open logging opt-in via SIGNATURE_VIEWER_DEBUG.
Use the LibreOffice Flatpak fallback when sandbox MIME associations are unavailable.
Open saved documents through the host handler without document portal paths.
Diagnostic logging for the save/open document flow.
Use the real shared path when saving and opening extracted documents.
Show the "Open" button on the save confirmation toast.
Add an "Open" action to the save confirmation toast.
Smaller startup window that expands when the PDF preview is shown.
Correct shortcut label and a noticeably smaller startup window.
Compact startup window, wider layout for the PAdES preview, and a cleaner preview toolbar.
Detect PDF content inside CAdES envelopes, accent-styled action button and keyboard shortcuts.
UI string cleanup.
Simplified original document handling: open it for PDF files, save it for CAdES envelopes.
Open CSV and spreadsheet documents explicitly in LibreOffice Calc.
Launch Flatpak document handlers with explicit access to the shared download folder.
Open extracted CAdES documents directly through the host file opener in Flatpak.
Open generated documents through their file URI without exposing document-portal paths to external applications.
Fix opening extracted office and CSV documents from the Flatpak sandbox.
Robust handling of the "Open original document" action in sandboxed environments.
Initial release: CAdES/PAdES verification with in-app signature position preview.
